name: resizable
title: Resizable
purpose: Divide available space into two panels whose boundary can be adjusted by pointer or keyboard.
avoidFor: Content that cannot tolerate a constrained panel
More than two peers without nested groups
accessibility: The handle uses separator semantics with orientation and current percentage.
Arrow keys resize by step while Home and End move to limits.
Both panels preserve normal document and focus order.
commonMistakes: Hiding the handle without another visible boundary.
Using Resizable where responsive stacking is clearer.
